title: Principal arcsine angle · Set 2
hints: Sine is unchanged by subtracting its angle from $\pi$.
Compare the two angles with the principal range.
The positive reference angle is inside the arcsine range.
solution: The inner sine equals $\sin(\pi/[$a])$ and $\pi/[$a]$ lies in the principal interval $[-\pi/2,\pi/2]$.

feedback.message: The positive reference angle is inside the arcsine range.
